changelog: **Every paywall gets a door — and a mentee never sees one (#1745):** new `<UpgradePrompt>` (`src/components/UpgradePrompt.tsx`, `data-testid="upgrade-prompt"`) renders a parsed 403 — `plan_limit_reached` or `feature_locked` — as what is blocked, the plan that lifts it at its published price (`liftFor()` in `src/lib/upgradePrompt.ts`, from `plans.ts`: the next programme plan whose band exceeds the cap, the cheapest plan of the screen's wallet that includes the feature, or the AI pack add-on), the reassurance that existing mentees, mentors and mentorships are unaffected, and the next step: **Request an upgrade** (`POST /api/org/plan-change`, admins only) or "your programme admin has been notified" / "ask your programme admin". Every word is from the new `upgrade` dictionary block (EN/TR/DE, MARKETING overlay), parsed from the `code` (`parseGateBody()` / `parseGateError()`), never from the server's English `error`. Wired at the admin assignment dialog, the inline assign, the request queue, the mentor's add-mentee form, the mentor's request decisions, the talent-pool locked card (employer wallet; the 403 now carries `code`/`feature`) and the premium-analytics locked panel (which pointed at a retired settings toggle). The mentee-facing gate on `POST /api/apply` now answers the same capacity refusal as a full mentor (`409 mentor_full`, shown as the translated "not taking applications" panel) and `notifyAdminsOfPlanLimit()` tells the org's admins instead (new in-app event `plan_limit.reached`, at most once per admin per 24h; the mentor paths report `adminsNotified`). `e2e/upgrade-prompt.spec.ts` fails if a plan name or a price reaches an `/apply` body.

en: When a plan limit or a locked feature blocks you, you now see which plan lifts it, its price, and a button to request the upgrade — in your language.
tr: Bir plan sınırı ya da kilitli bir özellik sizi durdurduğunda, artık hangi planın bunu açtığını, fiyatını ve yükseltme talep etme düğmesini kendi dilinizde görürsünüz.
de: Wenn Sie ein Plan-Limit oder eine gesperrte Funktion aufhält, sehen Sie jetzt, welcher Plan sie freischaltet, zu welchem Preis, und eine Schaltfläche für die Upgrade-Anfrage — in Ihrer Sprache.
